context: Sho and Hina look at a world map together.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、世界、こんなに、大きい。
lines.en: Sho — the world is so big.
lines.style: Bright, awed opening. Natural child voice, unselfconscious wonder. Soft warm tone throughout. Slight breathiness on 'big' like she's amazed at the size of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet, genuinely observant. Small, warm voice. No performance — just noticing something true. Soft pace, steady.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: ひな、ここの国、行きたい。
lines.en: I want to go to this one.
lines.style: Bright, pointing finger in voice. Warm wish without hesitation. Child sincerity — no false sophistication. Opening attack on the desire, soft trailing off on the place.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Quiet commitment. Small voice but unmoved. No hedging — six-year-old certainty. Warm throughout. Lands firmly on 'go'.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: いつか、絶対、二人で、見よう。
lines.en: Someday we'll see it together, for sure.
lines.style: Promise-voice. Child firmness on the certainty. Warm, genuine closing. Like she's making a real vow, not playing. Slight lift at the end.
